name: MTAC 510 902 MAX (MTAC, 902 gr)

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .510, Grains 902, Minimum Required Twist *1-14", Part Number MTAC 510 902 MAX, G1 BC 1.07, G7 BC .546, OAL 2.731", Bullet Projection 2.034"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 2.034".
